turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on the past simple with -ed?
turns.tutor:
Let us start from the present: I talk to my friend every day.
Worked example for yesterday. Step 1: talk is a regular verb. Step 2: keep talk and add -ed. Result: Yesterday I talked to my friend.
The rule: for a finished past action, add -ed to a regular verb.
Right: He climbed the hill. Wrong: He climb the hill last week.
Your turn: Last summer we ___ (stay) at a hotel.
